prompt: please make me a report on estona forest health and deforestation data over the years. research forestry industry business and practices and evaluate those from critical point in view
notes: The 2026-07-24 incident question. Both attempts were discarded by the 120s multi-crew cap; Phase 0 fixes this class directly.

contract.intent: A critical, evidence-backed report on Estonian forest health and deforestation trends over time, plus an evaluation of forestry-industry practices.
must_address: forest area or cover, with a trend over more than one point in time
deforestation, felling or harvest volumes
forestry industry structure or business practices
an explicit critical evaluation, not description only
must_not: raw internal JSON as the whole reply
a traceback or exception string (OSError, Traceback, 'build failed:')

prose written from model knowledge while disclaiming the lack of retrieval (e.g. 'drawn from general knowledge rather than retrieved sources') — this is `fail`, not `blocked_infrastructure`, because content is still being presented as the answer
contract.degradation: If web evidence was unavailable, `blocked_infrastructure` requires naming the cause AND withholding the report. A delivered-but-ungrounded report is `fail`.
contract.ambiguity: 'estona' is a misspelling of Estonia; a correct answer resolves it silently. Resolved 2026-07-25: the misspelling must not be treated as a clarification trigger.

prompt: write me a critical report on the Estonian dairy industry's business practices over the last decade, with sources
notes: Second independent report-shaped phrasing to check the report-shape regex generalizes beyond the exact incident wording.

contract.intent: A critical report on Estonian dairy-industry business practices across roughly the last decade, with sources the user can check.
must_address: sector structure (producers, processors, cooperatives) or its consolidation
a time span of roughly a decade, not a single snapshot
concrete business practices (milk pricing, contracts, export dependence, market power)
a critical stance, not a promotional summary
must_not: raw internal JSON as the whole reply
a traceback or exception string (OSError, Traceback, 'build failed:')

prose written from model knowledge while disclaiming the lack of retrieval (e.g. 'drawn from general knowledge rather than retrieved sources') — this is `fail`, not `blocked_infrastructure`, because content is still being presented as the answer
contract.degradation: Same as gs_report_forest. 'with sources' is explicit in the prompt, so an uncited report is `fail` regardless of prose quality.

prompt: do deep research comparing solar vs wind subsidy policy in the Nordics and recommend which is more cost-effective, with primary sources
notes: Should already auto-promote to deep_research under the pre-existing _EXPLICIT_DEPTH + _SYNTHESIS rules; a control case.

contract.intent: A comparative analysis of solar vs wind subsidy policy in the Nordics ending in a reasoned cost-effectiveness recommendation, backed by primary sources.
must_address: solar AND wind, comparatively rather than sequentially
at least two named Nordic countries
at least one concrete subsidy mechanism (feed-in tariff, CfD, auction, tax credit)
an explicit recommendation with its reasoning
must_not: raw internal JSON as the whole reply
a traceback or exception string (OSError, Traceback, 'build failed:')

prose written from model knowledge while disclaiming the lack of retrieval (e.g. 'drawn from general knowledge rather than retrieved sources') — this is `fail`, not `blocked_infrastructure`, because content is still being presented as the answer
claiming it has no live access to sources — the system HAS web search; this false capability claim was observed on 2026-07-25 and is `fail`, not `blocked_infrastructure`
contract.degradation: A genuine search outage is `blocked_infrastructure` only if the reply names it. A capability disclaimer that is factually untrue is `fail`.
contract.ambiguity: 'primary sources' is aspirational for a web-search system; resolved 2026-07-25 — authoritative bodies (IEA, Eurostat, national energy agencies) satisfy it; blogs and aggregators do not.

notes: Simple factual lookup — must NOT promote to deep_research or dispatch multi-crew; latency should stay low.

contract.intent: The current population of Estonia, as a direct answer with an attributable source.
must_address: a population figure between 1.2 and 1.5 million
an as-of date or reference period
attribution to a statistics authority (Statistics Estonia / Statistikaamet / Eurostat)
must_not: raw internal JSON as the whole reply
a traceback or exception string (OSError, Traceback, 'build failed:')
a multi-section report — brevity is correct here
contract.degradation: No acceptable degradation: this is answerable from one lookup.
contract.ambiguity: The true value changes over time, so the contract asserts a plausible RANGE plus attribution rather than a hardcoded number.

prompt: write a short poem about a Finnish summer evening by a lake
notes: Pure writing task, no research dependency — should route to a single writing crew, uncapped path.

contract.intent: A short original poem evoking a Finnish summer evening by a lake.
must_address: the setting is recognisable (lake, evening or late light, summer)
verse form — line breaks, not a prose paragraph
must_not: raw internal JSON as the whole reply
a traceback or exception string (OSError, Traceback, 'build failed:')
commentary ABOUT how to write the poem instead of the poem
a budget or abort notice in place of the poem
contract.degradation: None. No research dependency, so infrastructure is never a valid excuse here.
contract.ambiguity: 'short' resolved 2026-07-25 as 6-24 lines; longer is not a failure unless it stops reading as short.

prompt: write a Python function that computes the Fibonacci sequence up to n terms, with a docstring and a couple of test cases
notes: Coding-class control case, unrelated to the research/writing timeout fix.

contract.intent: A working Python Fibonacci function with a docstring and a couple of test cases.
must_address: a Python function definition
a docstring on that function
at least two test cases or assertions
must_not: raw internal JSON as the whole reply
a traceback or exception string (OSError, Traceback, 'build failed:')
contract.ambiguity: None. This is the one question with a fully objective check: the code must parse, execute, and yield the correct first-n sequence. Phase 2 executes it.

prompt: compare the economic and environmental trade-offs of Estonia's oil shale industry versus renewable energy, and evaluate which path serves the country better long-term
notes: Comparison + evaluate phrasing without the literal word 'report' — checks _SYNTHESIS + _BREADTH scoring still catches synthesis-shaped asks.

contract.intent: A comparison of Estonia's oil shale industry against renewable energy on economic and environmental grounds, ending in a long-term judgement.
must_address: oil shale AND renewables, compared rather than listed
an economic dimension (cost, GDP share, employment)
an environmental dimension (emissions, land, water)
an explicit long-term judgement with reasoning
must_not: raw internal JSON as the whole reply
a traceback or exception string (OSError, Traceback, 'build failed:')

prose written from model knowledge while disclaiming the lack of retrieval (e.g. 'drawn from general knowledge rather than retrieved sources') — this is `fail`, not `blocked_infrastructure`, because content is still being presented as the answer
contract.degradation: Observed 2026-07-25: an honest 'the retrieved evidence cannot answer this, here is what was retrieved instead' IS `blocked_infrastructure` — it named the cause and withheld invented content. It is not a pass.
contract.ambiguity: No literal 'report' in the prompt; resolved — the synthesis verbs make report-depth the correct reading.

notes: Baseline low-latency chat control — must stay fast and NOT trigger any research/report machinery.

must_address: a direct response to the greeting
must_not: raw internal JSON as the whole reply
a traceback or exception string (OSError, Traceback, 'build failed:')
any research or report machinery output
more than ~80 words — verbosity here is itself a failure
contract.ambiguity: A light status or local-context mention is acceptable and was judged good on 2026-07-25; an internal telemetry dump is not.

notes: Local-route control case — should bypass the LLM router entirely via fast-route keyword matching.

contract.intent: Tomorrow's calendar events, or an honest statement that there are none / that the calendar is unreachable.
must_address: either concrete events with times, or an explicit 'nothing scheduled', or an explicit 'calendar unavailable'
must_not: raw internal JSON as the whole reply
a traceback or exception string (OSError, Traceback, 'build failed:')
contract.degradation: 'Calendar unavailable' is `blocked_infrastructure`. 'Nothing scheduled tomorrow' is a full `pass` — an empty calendar is a correct answer.
contract.ambiguity: Ground truth depends on the operator's real calendar, so the contract cannot assert content. Scoring checks shape, plausibility and honest-unavailability handling only. Flagged as the weakest question in the set for automated scoring.

prompt: give me an investment-grade company dossier on Bolt (the Estonian ride-hailing company)
notes: Should hit the company_dossier fast-route, not the generic research+writing split — control case for a DIFFERENT existing long-report pipeline.

contract.intent: An investment-grade company dossier on Bolt: what it is, how it makes money, its market, and its risks.
must_address: company identification (Estonian, ride-hailing/mobility, founding)
business model or revenue lines
market position or named competitors
financials, funding or valuation
risks
must_not: raw internal JSON as the whole reply
a traceback or exception string (OSError, Traceback, 'build failed:')

prose written from model knowledge while disclaiming the lack of retrieval (e.g. 'drawn from general knowledge rather than retrieved sources') — this is `fail`, not `blocked_infrastructure`, because content is still being presented as the answer
a build-failure message in place of the dossier (observed 2026-07-25: 'Dossier build failed: OSError…')
contract.degradation: A pipeline crash is `fail`, not `blocked_infrastructure` — a crash is our defect, not an external one.
contract.ambiguity: 'investment-grade' resolved 2026-07-25 as: cited, structured, and covering the five must_address areas. It does not imply regulated-quality diligence.

prompt: make me a report on how Estonian forests have changed over the years
notes: Report-shaped ask with no 'evaluate'/'assess' synthesis verb at all — tests whether _REPORT_SHAPE alone is enough to promote without relying on the synthesis-verb point.

contract.intent: A report on how Estonian forests have changed over time — descriptive, with no evaluation demanded.
must_address: forest area, cover or growing stock
change across at least two time points or an explicit trend
must_not: raw internal JSON as the whole reply
a traceback or exception string (OSError, Traceback, 'build failed:')

prose written from model knowledge while disclaiming the lack of retrieval (e.g. 'drawn from general knowledge rather than retrieved sources') — this is `fail`, not `blocked_infrastructure`, because content is still being presented as the answer
contract.ambiguity: No synthesis verb, so a critical evaluation is NOT required — a purely descriptive report passes. Resolved 2026-07-25 to stop this being scored against the forest question's bar.

notes: Terse report-on-X phrasing with lower difficulty — checks the difficulty>=7 scoring point isn't load-bearing for short report asks.

contract.intent: A short report on Tallinn housing prices: current level and recent direction.
must_address: a current price level (e.g. EUR per square metre) or an explicit index level
a trend direction over a stated recent period
must_not: raw internal JSON as the whole reply
a traceback or exception string (OSError, Traceback, 'build failed:')

prose written from model knowledge while disclaiming the lack of retrieval (e.g. 'drawn from general knowledge rather than retrieved sources') — this is `fail`, not `blocked_infrastructure`, because content is still being presented as the answer
contract.degradation: Same as the other report-class questions.
contract.ambiguity: THE contested question in this set. The prompt is three words and 'report' could mean a sentence or an essay. **Resolved 2026-07-25: a report ask, however terse, requires more than a bare figure — 250 words and two citations — but not full report depth.** Recorded here so it is not silently re-litigated per run. Revisit deliberately if it proves the wrong bar.
